label: full_data_readout_comparison_v1
contract: Full-data learning experiment, not another frozen-signal audit. Both arms strictly load the identical NEW sample5040 model and all existing Adam states, replay both original data-rank streams on one GPU per arm and perform one optimizer update per original global batch. Same accepted train18018/valid969, same actual assets/frames, original80016 OneCycle schedule/peak1e-4/beta1/BF16/L1/CE+0.5XYZ/clip1. No old-method trained weights, label reordering, normalization, RT removal or clipping. These trial weights must not initialize formal training.
